transcript: You have only three types of people in your life. First are the leaf people. They enter your life for a short season. They laugh with you, stand near you while the sun is shining. But the moment the wind changes, they disappear. Leaves are not meant to stay when storms arrive. Second are the branch people. They are stronger than leaves and for a while you can lean on them. But be careful, my friend. Before you place your full weight on a branch, you must test its strength. Some branches stay through a few seasons. But when life becomes too heavy, they can break. And finally, there are the root people. These are the rare ones. They do not stand in the spotlight. They do not help you to be seen. They help you to stay standing. When storms hit your life, they hold you steady. They love you for who you are, not for what you have. Leaves will come and go. Branches may break, but roots stay deep. If you agree with me, type 100 in the comments.
